questions.question: What does the theoretical BF16 Roofline ridge point, \(1000 \times \text{TFLOP/s} / \text{GB/s}\) in FLOP/byte, describe?
options: How many SSH keys can connect to the TPU VM
The arithmetic intensity where the ideal HBM-bandwidth ceiling meets the ideal BF16-compute ceiling
How long `gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create` takes to provision
questions.explanation: Convert both rates to FLOP/s and byte/s first. The ratio locates the intersection of two ideal ceilings. Below it the bandwidth ceiling is lower; above it the compute ceiling is lower. Actual performance can fall below either ceiling because of tiling, communication, vector work or launch overhead.
optionFeedback: A roofline ratio describes compute and memory rates. Authentication and SSH limits belong to a different control-plane contract.
